name: kagura-memory
description: Kagura Memory Cloud plugin — restore session context, recall & save durable project knowledge, setup help, an MCP smoke test, and tool-guardrail hooks

server_url.title: Kagura Memory MCP URL
server_url.description: The MCP endpoint from .mcp.json — the whole URL, ending in /mcp or /mcp/w/<workspace-id>, never the site root. Example: https://<host>/mcp (or https://<host>/mcp/w/<workspace-id>). The hooks POST load_guardrails to exactly this URL, so a site root answers http 404/405 and no guardrail is ever delivered. Add ?guardrails=off to the .mcp.json URL itself (&guardrails=off when the URL already has a query, such as ?profile=core) so the server does not also send a guardrail digest.

api_key.title: Kagura API key
api_key.description: A user API key (kagura_...). Agent-bound keys can read guardrails but not author them.

context_id.title: Guardrail context id
context_id.description: A UUID from list_contexts (the context's id, not its name), naming the context whose guardrails apply. One context for all projects in v1. /kagura-memory:setup picks it for you.

max_action.title: Strongest hook action
max_action.description: block: a block guardrail denies the matching call once, with the memory as the reason. inform: never deny, only add context.
